policy.contamination_rule: Every motivating source material identity is permanently included in the derived Framework V001 hypothesis contamination set.
policy.downstream_boundary: No strategy specification, implementation, discovery, validation, scoring, publication, Olympics, governance, or trading authority is granted.
policy.evidence_claim: Literature and documented behavior motivate falsifiable questions but provide no repository-specific edge evidence.
policy.mutation_rule: Any semantic change requires a new child registration identity; in-place mutation is prohibited.
